text: Pogačar's relentless pace has already fractured Vingegaard's confidence—the two-time champion is burning matches just to limit damage—but a completely flat 181km sprint stage hands the initiative to Evenepoel's Red Bull-Bora team, who've shown they'll weaponize teammate strength to destabilize UAE's control. Visma can't afford another passive day watching rivals dictate tempo, yet their sprinter depth is thin enough that Vingegaard may have to ride defense again rather than attack. Watch whether Pedersen's points-jersey grip tempts Lidl-Trek into chasing breakaways that could fracture the peloton before the finish—or whether they'll sit tight, letting the sprinter teams do the dirty work.
